entries.german: Erzbischof Gerlach bekundet seine Einwilligung dazu, daß der Ritter Engelhard von Rosenberg, sein lieber Getreuer, seine Frau bewidmet hat auf seiner Hälfte des vom Erzstifte zu Lehen gehenden Hofes zu Walldürn (Durn) und dem Zugehörigen.
entries.english: Archbishop Gerlach attests his consent to the endowment that Ritter Engelhard von Rosenberg, his dear faithful servant, has settled on his wife over his half of the court at Walldürn and its appurtenances, which are held as a fief from the archbishopric.
